nodes.label: Headline finding: opposite seeds for the two regime families
nodes.rationale: Which Gray-Scott pattern you get is set as much by the seed as by feed/kill; low-feed regimes need small nuclei, high-feed regimes need large ones; no single initial condition brings all presets to life. The equation itself was never the bug.
nodes.norm_label: headline finding: opposite seeds for the two regime families

nodes.label: GPU ping-pong float-texture simulation architecture
nodes.rationale: Stateful ping-pong between two RG32F textures across five fragment passes (sim, splat, seed, display, copy, rescale), drawn as a full-screen triangle; React never touches a pixel.

nodes.label: Float16 to float32 precision fix (RG16F to RG32F)
nodes.rationale: RG16F has ~3 significant digits so tiny per-step increments near U~1 round away, killing delicate high-kill regimes; switching to RG32F revived them, needing EXT_color_buffer_float and OES_texture_float_linear, with RG16F as fallback.
nodes.norm_label: float16 to float32 precision fix (rg16f to rg32f)

nodes.label: resize() re-seed bug masquerading as always-near-empty
nodes.rationale: resize() used to re-seed the grid on every canvas size change; ResizeObserver fires repeatedly during layout, wiping the developing field each time. Fixed by preserving the field via a rescale-blit and only seeding on first allocation or explicit reset.
nodes.norm_label: resize() re-seed bug masquerading as always-near-empty

nodes.label: Seeding research: jittered grid of mixed-size hard-cored nuclei
nodes.rationale: Progression: flooding V acted as an eraser; a sane nucleus still had opposite size needs per regime family; the final seed uses a jittered grid (not random), mixed sizes (radius 6 and 18), and a hard core (uInner=0.8) rather than a soft dome, giving all eight presets 33-98% fill reliably across reloads.
nodes.norm_label: seeding research: jittered grid of mixed-size hard-cored nuclei

nodes.label: Verification methodology: CPU reference + live GPU oracle + debug panel
nodes.rationale: For a GPU sim, expose the engine's aggregate state as text and measure pixels; never conclude from a screenshot, never trust an offline model over the live device on a marginal case.
nodes.norm_label: verification methodology: cpu reference + live gpu oracle + debug panel
